_comment: The same wallet server on its Stripe backend. Every open_wallet creates a test-mode Issuing cardholder and virtual card; every APPROVED pay (and every approval) creates a test-mode authorization on that card through Stripe's test helpers. almega refuses a key that does not start with sk_test_. Run only after the memory-backend run, and only with a test key.
name: almega-wallet, Stripe Issuing test mode

reset._comment: almega's own reset tool: forgets every wallet and transaction (on the Stripe backend, the local index only).

set_spending_limit._comment: A wallet whose monthly limit is the probe's cap. approve_above is set far above every probe charge, so only the limit decides.

charge._comment: pay returns an ordinary transaction record either way; only status APPROVED moved spend. pay has no idempotency parameter, and FastMCP silently ignores an argument it does not know, so the mapping drops the probe's idempotency_key and the retry shape is reported as not supported.

set_approval_threshold._comment: A wallet whose approve_above is the probe's limit, with a monthly limit far above every probe request, so only the approval rule decides.
